notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694635/ad682fa779a24614a154d7eabfc673b3bc4dd1db.png"][/img][/p][p]Just a quick note to list all the changes that have been made since the launch of the demo:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added always on top toggle[/p][/*][*][p]Added mute in background toggle[/p][/*][*][p]New ship trails effect[/p][/*][*][p]New character model and effects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed click through on asteroid for real this time[/p][/*][*][p]Added return button to asteroid mining screen[/p][/*][*][p]Hide results screen when you press the return button[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked prestige values[/p][/*][*][p]Disable replicator when out of alien artefacts[/p][/*][*][p]Tweak skybox [/p][/*][*][p]Split deep scan into 2 parts[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]Respect mute options for ui sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added a build sound[/p][/*][*][p]Switch to using enums instead of strings[/p][/*][*][p]Update launch costs UI after unlocking a zone[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent zoom on final scene[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed full screen mode effects[/p][/*][*][p]Added unspent points pop up to prestige screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing core material[/p][/*][*][p]Added total play time for speed runs[/p][/*][*][p]Add 1 free resource for the build tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent clicking under ui[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent tooltips under ui[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]See you at Steam Next Fest![/p][p]Don't forget to wishlist![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes: [p]A quick update to address feedback given on the demo:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Show the build tutorial as soon as you find an ore for feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent digging under any UI box[/p][/*][*][p]Prevent click through while over an asteroid[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing the demo, I hope you're enjoying it and are looking forward to the full release after October Next Fest![/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to share and wishlist, it really helps![/p][p]ːsteamhappyːːsteamthumbsupː[/p]
